verdict.rationale: The Stagehand SDK offers natural-language selectors in place of hand-written ones (docs-5), and Browserbase claims agents can pull data from any website and convert URLs into JSON (docs-3, docs-8, docs-12). However, no evidence shows an LLM extraction call that reads a page and itself chooses which structured fields to return. missing for 10: explicit docs for LLM-driven structured/schema extraction, evidence that the model decides the fields rather than just locating elements, independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.
